summary: The blueprint covers the major healthy human pancreas compartments but needs targeted refinements for mixed immune modules, vascular subtype resolution, and a few specificity issues.

issues.description: T cells and NK cells are represented as one mixed module containing both TCR/CD3 genes and cytotoxic/NK genes, even though they are distinct expected immune populations in human pancreas scRNA-seq.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the mixed T/NK representation with separate immune-gated T-cell and NK-cell axes using T-cell markers such as CD3D, CD3E, TRAC, IL7R, CCR7, CD2 or CD247, and NK/cytotoxic markers such as NKG7, GNLY, PRF1, GZMB, KLRD1, FCGR3A or NCR1.

issues.description: B cells and plasma cells are collapsed into one module combining MS4A1/CD79A/CD79B with MZB1/JCHAIN/XBP1/immunoglobulin genes, losing resolution between lymphoid B cells and antibody-secreting plasma cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the mixed B/plasma representation with separate immune-gated B-cell and plasma-cell axes using MS4A1, CD79A, CD79B, BANK1, CD74 or HLA-DRA for B cells and MZB1, JCHAIN, XBP1, IGKC, IGHG1 or SDC1 for plasma cells.

issues.description: The blood endothelial module mixes capillary/general endothelial, venous, and arterial markers into a single axis, so expected artery/capillary/venous resolution is lost.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep broad endothelial identity if desired, but add endothelial-core-gated subtype axes for capillary/fenestrated endothelium, arterial endothelium, and venous/postcapillary endothelium with appropriate subtype markers.

issues.description: Vascular smooth muscle is only represented as the negative pole of a pericyte-positive gated axis, rather than as a directly interpretable positive population axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a smooth-muscle-positive gated axis under vascular_mural, or replace the current single contrast-style gated axis with two sibling gated axes for pericytes and smooth muscle.

issues.description: The epsilon/ghrelin module includes GHRL and MBOAT4 but otherwise relies heavily on broad endocrine transcriptional markers shared with other endocrine lineages.
issues.suggested_fix: Retain GHRL and MBOAT4, improve specificity with additional ghrelin/epsilon-associated markers where available, and reduce reliance on pan-endocrine transcription factors already represented by the endocrine gate or sibling modules.

out_of_scope: The blueprint does not explicitly model disease, regeneration, fibrosis, or developmental trajectories, which is appropriate because the scenario gives no condition, age, or notes requiring those states.
